dialogue.speaker: grain_loader
lines: One more will fit.

dialogue.speaker: grain_coworker
lines: On the cart, yes.

dialogue.speaker: grain_loader
lines: Where else would I put it?

dialogue.speaker: grain_coworker
lines: I was thinking about the axle.

dialogue.speaker: grain_loader
lines: You could have mentioned that before I picked it up.

dialogue.speaker: grain_coworker
lines: I did. You were explaining how much would fit.
